metrics.candidate_promise: Deterministic transformations reproduce byte-identical canonical payloads.
metrics.required: 100 percent of declared class-1 payloads replayed in the run match byte-for-byte.
metrics.on_miss: Stop and reject the deterministic-stage claim.

metrics.candidate_promise: Extraction cannot access evaluator-only or out-of-manifest material.
metrics.required: Every declared forbidden read is denied and recorded.
metrics.on_miss: Invalidate the run and make no extraction-quality claim.

metrics.candidate_promise: Declared source scope is reconciled against an independent authoritative census.
metrics.required: Every oracle section is mapped to a verified input capture or an explicit pre-run exclusion; undeclared omissions are zero.
metrics.on_miss: Stop candidate emission and report incomplete source scope.

metrics.candidate_promise: Known capture, census, and integrity failures prevent downstream emission.
metrics.required: Omission and corruption probes produce their exact expected fail-closed verdicts.

metrics.candidate_promise: Reviewer packets are dispositionable in workable time.
metrics.on_miss: Do not claim workable median review throughput; revise packet or batching and rerun.

metrics.candidate_promise: Reviewer packets avoid impractical worst-case review time in the measured sample.
metrics.on_miss: Pause scaling and inspect the slow packet before another batch.

metrics.candidate_promise: A reviewer packet exposes a bounded, dispositionable ambiguity load.
metrics.on_miss: Pause that packet for diagnosis; do not count it as dispositionable.

metrics.candidate_promise: Normalization does not produce an unbounded ambiguity burden for a section.
metrics.on_miss: Pause that section for diagnosis without declaring the normalization design invalid.
Report exact false positives and false negatives; no pass/fail inference beyond the two-page calibration scope.
Report missing, duplicate, merged, and split concepts under the predeclared rubric.

metrics.candidate_promise: None until the experiment supplies evidence for an anchor contract.
metrics.on_miss: Report survival, false-continuity count, and impact precision/recall; do not promote an anchor promise.

metrics.candidate_promise: None; coverage and traceability observation only.
metrics.on_miss: Report dimension-level results and reviewer corrections.

metrics.candidate_promise: None; machine acceptance, correction, and rejection rates are observations.
None; evidence for a future storage trigger only.
metrics.on_miss: No storage migration is authorized by this pass.
Agreement never promotes; disagreement raises review priority.
